purpose: This table is the clean carrier reference lookup from the nycflights13 Bureau of Transportation Statistics source, mapping two-letter carrier codes to full carrier names for the sixteen airlines that flew out of New York City in 2013; it is intended to be joined to flight-level fact tables on the carrier code.
usage: Join on carrier to enrich flight or other fact records with the full carrier name; both carrier and name are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and carrier is unique across all 16 rows, so no null-handling or deduplication logic is required by consumers.
limitations: The source is a small, static reference table (row_count 16) with no duplicate rows and no nulls in either column, so no cleanup beyond dropping the three Airbyte capture-tool columns was needed; consumers should be aware this table only covers carriers active in the 2013 NYC flights dataset and will not include carriers added or retired since.
